title: T16 — Project context (retrospective, 2026-11-23)
body:
# T16 — Project context (retrospective, 2026-11-23)

## Context

```
operators ──SOP──┐
analysts ──RDF/OWL──┼──> procedures.ingest_* ──> drafts (one store)
modellers ──BPMN/Visio/draw.io──┘                        │
                                                          v
                              human publication gate ──> published procedure
                                                          │
                                    process engine <── bound job runs PDDL steps
```

## Affected organisation

- Operations and procedure owners supply and review the sources.
- Procedure publishers decide publication; the drafting job cannot.
- The Architecture Board approves the contract and the Phase-G review.
- Programme governance authorises tranche 4 and reads the closure.

## Affected systems

- The conveyor action registry (`procedures.*`) and its HTTP/MCP projections.
- PostgreSQL — procedure, draft and knowledge-pack rows, tenant-scoped.
- Object storage for source bytes; the knowledge pack remains referenced, not copied.
- The process engine that executes a reviewed, bound procedure's PDDL steps.
- The documents surface that publishes the closure evidence.
